channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Trump’s first ‘Quad’ summit gives bloc much-needed momentum. But will it last?
item.description: While the Japanese and Indian leaders said the meeting would give the grouping fresh momentum, doubts about its sustainability remain.

item.title: Japan to help support employment of Myanmar refugees in Thailand
item.description: Japan will provide through grant aid equipment for vocational training and help establish a system to enable companies to hire the refugees.

item.title: Rakuten Securities account information compromised in major data breach
item.description: Personal and banking data from 4.47 million accounts may have been exposed, though the company said passwords needed to conduct trades were safe.

item.title: Over half of drivers drove through floodwater during Chiba’s torrential rain: survey
item.description: The survey of 1,500 people, conducted by the University of Tokyo and others, suggests many drivers continued driving despite recognizing the danger.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
